description: The payload used to create a project role. It is optional for CMP projects, as a default role actor will be provided. TMP will add new role actors to the table.

defaultActors.description: The default actors for the role. By adding default actors, the role will be added to any future projects created

onConflict.description: The strategy to use when there is a conflict with an existing project role. FAIL - Fail execution, this always needs to be unique; USE - Use the existing entity and ignore new entity parameters

type.description: The type of the role. Only used by project-scoped project
